title: Aigarth-it production code inspection — Anna usage falsification
key_finding: Anna is NOT integrated into the official aigarth-it library. All Phase B/C/D experiments using ITUClAnnaInit are tests of a hypothesis we constructed (what if Anna were used as ITU init), not measurements of CfB's official Aigarth deployment. Anna's actual intended usage remains undocumented.
honest_revision: Phase B/C/D measured 'Anna-init effect on aigarth-it ITU' — a test scenario WE built to investigate whether Anna's structure helps. The advantages we found (+0.05 hit rate on addition, +30% genuine task signal on bit-selecting operations) are REAL for that specific setup, but the production aigarth-it uses random initialization, so this advantage is not currently exploited.
